findings.title: findByName instructed to be ADDED to ClientRepository where it already exists
findings.where: Module 1.4 (resolving/seeding the demo client) and Finding 4 resolution row
findings.problem: xamops ClientRepository already declares Optional<Client> findByName(String name) (used by GoogleAuthController.uniqueClientName). Re-adding it is a duplicate method declaration and fails compilation of xamops-service, breaking AC-36.
findings.fix: Add only Optional<Client> findFirstByDemoTrue(); to ClientRepository. Reuse the existing findByName(String) as-is. Update both the Module 1.4 text and the Finding 4 row.

findings.title: Design drops 'display name' field required by AC-28 / R8
findings.where: Module 2.3 (Name column dropped), DemoUserDto record, Module 3.6 table columns
findings.problem: R8 and AC-28 list 'display name' as a required (non-optional) returned field; only 'last IP' is optional. The design removes it entirely, so AC-28 as written cannot pass. The reasoning (persisted username == email; no name column on User) is factually correct and verified, but the design resolves the conflict by silently dropping a required field instead of reconciling design and requirements.
findings.fix: Either (a) keep a name field in DemoUserDto sourced from AppUser.username and render a Name column (satisfies AC-28 literally, column currently equals Email), or (b) formally amend AC-28/R8 to drop 'display name' and record the deviation. Surface the choice explicitly rather than burying it in a design note.

findings.title: Wrong file path cited for billops User entity
findings.problem: Cites billops/src/main/java/com/xammer/billops/domain/User.java, which does not exist. Actual path is billops/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/domain/User.java (package com.xammer.cloud.domain) — which the same paragraph also names correctly, contradicting itself. The minimal-mapping conclusion is verified correct.
findings.fix: Replace the com/xammer/billops/domain/User.java path with com/xammer/cloud/domain/User.java.

findings.title: Billops impersonation constant name quoted imprecisely
findings.problem: Refers to the billops UserActivityEvent constant as IMPERSONATION_STARTED; the actual constant is ACTION_IMPERSONATION_STARTED (value 'IMPERSONATION_STARTED'), alongside OUTCOME_SUCCESS. Not material to the query but imprecise for an implementer adding a login constant.
findings.fix: Refer to it as ACTION_IMPERSONATION_STARTED; if adding a login constant, name it ACTION_LOGIN = "LOGIN" to mirror the xamops copy.
